description: Recolour an image to a game palette so assets from different sources match: PICO-8, Sweetie 16, Endesga 32, Game Boy, NES style or your own hex codes, or reduce it to its own best N colours. Optional ordered dithering for gradients. Transparency is kept.

colors.description: Without palette: reduce to this many of the image's own colours.

dither.description: 0 is flat colour, 1 is strong ordered dithering.

image_base64.description: The PNG file as base64 (a data: URL also works). Use instead of image_url.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a PNG image, up to about 128×128 pixels.

name.description: Short name for the output files.

palette.description: pico-8, sweetie-16, endesga-32, gameboy, nes-like, or hex codes like "#1a1c2c #b13e53 ...". Leave out and give colors to use the image's own colours.

name: apply_palette
title: Apply a palette
